news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.82 (vs ₹0.28 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.82 (up from ₹0.28 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹358.2m (up 30% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹8.40m (up 196% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.3% (up from 1.0% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 25% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 7% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: Yash Chemex Limited Announces Resignation of Ms. Pragati Jain as Whole Time Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 22, 2026
news.body: Yash Chemex Limited announced that Ms. Pragati Jain, Whole Time Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company, has tendered her resignation from the said post with effect from the close of business hours of January 22, 2026 to pursue alternate career opportunities. Ms. Pragati Jain has confirmed that there are no other material reasons for her resignation other than one specified above.

news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹893.1m (US$9.89m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook.
